slots.name: revenue guidance
slots.sentence: The Canadian women’s fashion retailer on Thursday boosted its revenue expectations for the 2027 fiscal year to 4.78 billion Canadian dollars ($3.35 billion) to C$4.88 billion, which would represent an increase of 29% to 32% from the prior year. It had previously guided for revenue of C$4.55 billion to C$4.75 billion.

slots.name: net income
slots.sentence: For the fiscal second-quarter ended Aug. 30, Aritzia posted net income of C$201.7 million, or C$1.70 a share, up from C$66.3 million, or C$0.56 a share, in the comparable quarter a year ago.

slots.name: adjusted EPS
slots.sentence: On an adjusted basis, which strips out exceptional items and one-off costs, earnings came to C$1.31 a share. According to FactSet, analysts were expecting C$1.05 a share.

slots.name: net revenue
slots.sentence: Net revenue rose 44% to C$1.17 billion, topping analyst forecasts of C$1.12 billion.

slots.name: US revenue
slots.sentence: In the U.S., revenue rose 35% to C$779.4 million, making up two-thirds of total revenue, while in Canada, net revenue rose 20% to C$390.4 million.

slots.name: digital sales
slots.sentence: Digital sales surged by 68% to C$402.9 million, now making up 34% of all sales, while sales at brick and mortar locations rose 34% to C$766.9 million.

slots.name: comparable sales
slots.sentence: Comparable sales growth, which tracks sales performance at existing locations open for at least a year, came to 35%.

slots.name: stock change
slots.sentence: Shares of Aritzia (ATZ.TO) surged more than 20% after the apparel retailer topped analyst expectations for second-quarter revenue and profit.
